description:
You are a security compliance officer at BuildingTech Solutions. A routine audit has flagged a policy violation: contractor personnel from external vendors must NEVER be members of the 'IT Department' or 'Security Staff' groups. These groups grant badge access to the server room and the security command center — areas that are off-limits to contractors under the company's access control policy.

Your task is to audit the 'IT Department' and 'Security Staff' groups in the 2N Access Commander system (https://localhost:9443, admin / 2n). Identify any users who are:
  (a) members of either restricted group, AND
  (b) employed by an external contractor company (i.e., NOT a BuildingTech Solutions employee)

For each violation found, remove that user from the restricted group. Do NOT remove any legitimate BuildingTech Solutions employees from these groups. Do NOT disable or delete any user accounts.

You are not given a list of violators — you must discover them by inspecting the system.
